concerns.text: Success Criterion SC-001 requires measuring cross‑validated R² against a null (mean‑predictor) baseline, but no task creates or records this baseline comparison. Add a concrete task (e.g., T017) that computes the null‑model R² on the held‑out test set and records it in `data/processed/cv_results.yaml` (or a separate file) with verification that the value is present and matches the mean‑predictor calculation.

The feasibility audit (T014) verifies runtime limits but does not explicitly assert that the pipeline respects the CPU‑only constraint (FR‑010). Add a verification step that checks the installed `xgboost` package is the CPU‑only build (e.g., `xgboost.__version__` and `xgboost.__config__` contain 'cpu') and fail the task if a GPU‑enabled binary is detected.

Task T006 mentions writing `descriptors.csv` with a `transformation_hash` per record, but does not specify how the hash is derived (e.g., hash of input composition vector, hash of script parameters). Clarify the hash generation method to make the task deterministic and verifiable.
